question: For the NXT title that had the shortest match (excluding titles with "title change"), what were the names of the two wrestlers involved?
sql:
SELECT m.duration, m.title_id, b.name as title_name, m.winner_id, m.loser_id, w.name as winner_name, l.name as loser_name
FROM Matches m 
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = b.id 
LEFT JOIN Wrestlers w ON m.winner_id = w.id
LEFT JOIN Wrestlers l ON m.loser_id = l.id
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%' 
AND m.title_change = 0
AND m.duration != ''
AND CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, 1, INSTR(m.duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, INSTR(m.duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) = 43
